    Integer cocycles on ray categories #

    An integer weight c on the arrows of the quiver of a ray category such that two paths with the same nonzero value have the same total weight (IsCocycle) induces a functor from the fundamental groupoid to the integers (cocycleFunctor). Hence a walk of nonzero total weight is not null-homotopic (not_trivial_of_weight).

    Cocycles detect simple connectedness: in a simply connected ray category every cocycle is a coboundary (isCoboundary_of_simplyConnected); conversely, a nontrivial homomorphism from the fundamental group to ℤ gives a cocycle that is not a coboundary (not_isCoboundary_homCocycle), so a free fundamental group is trivial as soon as every cocycle is a coboundary (eq_one_of_forall_isCoboundary).
